sites.name: Blue Lake
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $15 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night Group Site: $70 per night
sites.season: Facilities open as weather permits; usually mid-May to late October.
sites.about: Blue Lake campground is located on a gentle slope above beautiful Blue Lake. The 48 sites are large and well spaced with plenty of shade. Just a short walk down the hill takes you to the lake for fishing, swimming, boating and hiking. There is a paved trail along the east shore of the lake from…
sites.directions: From Alturas go south on US Hwy 395 to Likely, CA. Turn east on County Road 64/Jess Valley Rd and go 9 miles to Blue Lake Road. Turn right on Blue Lake Road and follow the signs approximately 8.5…
sites.restrictions: Dogs on leash only. Please clean up afeeter your dog. Camping limit 14 days.
sites.reservations: All individual campsites are "first come, first served." For group camp site information, please see Recreation.gov

sites.name: East Creek Equestrian Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.season: Facilities open as weather permits; usually late May to late October.
sites.about: East Creek Campground replaces Patterson Campground for horse camping and equestrian access to the South Warner Wilderness. sites.name: Mill Creek Falls Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $15 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.season: Facilities open as weather permits; usually early June to late October.
sites.about: Located on the edge of the South Warner Wilderness this campground is nestled in the thick pine forests above Jess Valley at the south end of the Warner Mountains. Its easy access makes for a perfect weekend get away.
